, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread/misrepresented the Britannica page that the WebSurfer opened, claiming it confirmed Yingtian as present-day Nanjing when the visible text on the page stated “Yingtian, Henan province, China.” This ignored a clear source discrepancy and failed to reconcile conflicting information, potentially leading to an incorrect birthplace conclusion.
